Maria (runtime): Heads-up — saw a perf regression after we enabled the new continuous gating heuristic. H100 tails look worse for mixed-length traffic, latency p50 unchanged but p95 up ~18%. Anyone else?
Alex G: Hmm, which workload? seq len distribution? any kernel selector logs?
Maria (runtime): Small med-sized chat workload (avg 180 tokens, spikes to 2k). Kernel selector is switching to fallback kernels mid-batch a lot. Attached quick profile below.
Maria (runtime): ```profile
sample: h100-3b | batch formation: 24 concurrent slices
avg seq: 180 | seq sd: 420
kernel_choices: fast_fused_attn: 48% | fallback_attention: 52%
kv_frag_ratio: 0.34
p95_latency: 342ms (baseline 289ms)
observed packing: many small token-limited batches + some big slot-formed batches
```
Jamal: kv_frag_ratio 0.34 is suspicious — KV fragmentation causing kernel fallback often. we saw similar on A100 during mixed-packing run.
Sasha: Is selector using the kernel-fit heuristic that depends on contiguous KV memory footprint? Might be misclassifying due to our recent slice-coalescing change.
Maria (runtime): Yup, selector logs show kernel_score delta flipping sign when slice sizes cross ~64k tokens. The coalescer sometimes produces a 3-slice batch [12k, 12k, 40k] => total 64k but internal layout favors fallback.
Alex G: Two quick levers: 1) adjust kernel selector threshold for fallback bias on H100, 2) change continuous-gating to prefer token-limited batches when fragmentation > X.
Kevin: Propose concrete per-GPU max_tokens_per_batch and max_batch_size targets to stabilize packing and bias kernel fit. From profiling/throughput sims we should try: H100 max_tokens_per_batch=180000, max_batch_size=32; A100=120000 / 28; A10=60000 / 20; T4=30000 / 16; L4=25000 / 12. These are starting points.
Jamal: I like that. Also add a frag_threshold metric to the queue policy: if kv_frag_ratio > 0.25 then cap batch growth and prefer token-gating for 60s.
Sasha: We should also tweak kernel selector's affinity scoring: penalize fallback by +0.08 score when contiguous_memory_estimate < 0.7. small change but could flip decisions back to fused kernels.
Alex G: Can we run an A/B: baseline vs (new gating + kernel threshold) on a canary node set? If p95 improves without losing throughput, we ship.
Maria (runtime): I'll run a canary with Kevin's per-GPU caps + Sasha's kernel penalty + Jamal's frag-based gate. Patch will be config-only.
Maria (runtime): Config snippet I'll apply to canary cluster:```json
{"selector": {"fallback_penalty": 0.08, "contig_memory_cutoff": 0.7}, "batching": {"per_gpu": {"H100": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 180000, "max_batch_size": 32}, "A100": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 120000, "max_batch_size": 28}, "A10": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 60000, "max_batch_size": 20}, "T4": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 30000, "max_batch_size": 16}, "L4": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 25000, "max_batch_size": 12}}, "frag_gate": {"enabled": true, "threshold": 0.25, "cooldown_s": 60}}}
```
deploy-bot: rolling config to canary nodes: runtime-canary-01..03 — started at 5178901380
Kevin: I'll run the synthetic mix tests (chat-like seq dist + bursts to 2k). will collect kernel selection traces and p95.
Jamal: I'll instrument kv allocator to emit contig_memory_estimate per-slot so we can verify selector heuristics.
Sasha: If canary looks good, add a small experiment: relax H100 max_tokens slightly (to 200k) to measure cost throughput tradeoff.
Maria (runtime): Great. Expected results window ~2h. I'll post back with p50/p95 and kernel-choice breakdown.
Alex G: Nice plan. Also add a perf-regression test that simulates mixed seeds so we don't regress again on slice-coalescer changes.
Maria (runtime): Will add test to nightly perf suite and link PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
